name: Komugi Pan
description: A warm, playful store theme for neighbourhood bakeries that sell loaves, pastries and sweet buns online: flour-cream pages with a faint flour-dust texture drawn in CSS, golden crust and rye-brown accents, white loaf-topped product cards with round price stickers set in a gentle cooling-rack zig-zag, Young Serif headings over Outfit text; a centred header with a round wheat badge between a split menu and a scalloped paper-bag edge, a product-first home page, a daily bake board that marks the trays already out of the oven, and a footer that opens with a strip of photographs from the week's ovens; with a bake schedule, about, a journal, a weekly loaf letter and contact, the address, hours, phone and bake times kept in two synced patterns so they are edited once, a dark Night Bake style variation, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.

fonts.role: headings, the wordmark, prices on the stickers and the bake-board times
fonts.copyright: Copyright 2023 The Young Serif Project Authors

fonts.role: body text, navigation, tags, buttons, tables and forms

store.withoutPlugin: The shop page lists every loaf, pastry and sweet bun with photographs and prices, and reservations go by phone or email; store templates are not used.
